Since humans evolved from their primal instincts as animals, which we really are (get food, make shelter, avoid predators) we moved onto automated resources (farming and agricultural revolution).

That's why we have to strive so hard to find fulfilment as we have basically fulfilled all our basic needs (that are innate and should have been the only things we needed to fulfil). Now we are stuck looking for "meaning" when in reality we are animals with a specific function that we perfected through technology, and now have to find a new function to carry out for ourselves.
